verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's GitHub README lists an "Interactive playground to test and generate request code" alongside the Dockerized FastAPI server, and its docs include code examples. That gives an interactive way to try requests, but there is no evidence of a full browsable API reference: probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate docs path. missing for 10: a documented interactive API reference covering all endpoints, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, detail on what the playground covers, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
